Subject: Residency + VPC evidence for SIG questionnaire — NovaMed

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As part of our SIG/CAIQ review we're compiling a short evidence bundle to validate region constraints and private network controls for our pilot (EU primary, APAC pilot in Q3). Our security team has two specific asks:

1) Documentation or diagrams demonstrating how requests from NovaMed can be pinned to EU-only hosting (no egress to other regions) and how failovers are handled.
2) Evidence that private connectivity (PrivateLink / VPC peering or equivalent) + KMS key partitioning are available for the EU deployment and can be segregated for the APAC pilot.

A simple PDF diagram + a short matrix or checklist is perfect; we can attach those to the SIG spreadsheet. Could you confirm what artifacts you can provide and an ETA? Also cc'ing security to highlight any technical questions.

Best,
Emily Chen
Director of Security Engineering
NovaMed

Lauren — forwarding Emily's request and your response. Quick notes from Platform Security:

- EU-only hosting: we support region pinning at the routing layer for hosted customers and for Dedicated/Private we can deploy customer resources into an EU-only VPC controlled by the customer's account or our isolated tenant. The diagram should show the control-plane separation (control vs data plane) and the routing policy that prevents egress to other regions.
- Failover: we provide an optional cross-region warm-standby policy; failover will only occur to a pre-approved region and only after a manual or prescriptive trigger (we will document the process).
- KMS: we can provide a KMS partitioning approach: either customer-managed keys in the customer's cloud account (recommended) or dedicated customer keys managed in our account with strict tenancy separation and rotated per-customer. The matrix attached includes sample IAM/KMS policy snippets.

Action items for the pack: Marcus — can you pull the current EU network diagram and remove any internal design notes? Priyom — can you export the KMS policy examples and add a one-paragraph description of the key tenancy tradeoffs?

Rishi
Principal Platform Security Engineer
